propositions: The differ's comment comparison key uses plain-character truncation at 32767 while the Cloud send path fits against serialized ADF at 32000 bytes, causing the dedup key to never match for over-length comments

For a 43200-char body, the comparison key is 32767 chars but the landed body is 31753 chars due to marker budget reservation, with divergence beginning around 31.8k plain length where ADF serialization crosses budget

The divergence was introduced in commit 27b868ba55 which moved the send path off the shared truncate_comment_body helper while leaving the differ on it, regressing from prior byte-identical convergence
The body-equality dedup layer is the guard against lost map writes between add_comment and record_comment_id and becomes structurally dead for over-length comments, allowing re-posting on every pass
The fix restores convergence by making _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment return the exact marker-free text the send path lands via fit_comment_as_sent composed with the flag-governed AdfCodec
